sources.quote: Marcus’ Meditations (the title due to the modern editor Casaubon)
The second century CE Roman emperor Marcus Aurelius was also a Stoic philosopher, and his Meditations
probably written while Marcus was on campaign in central Europe, c. C.E. 171-175
at least part of the work for which he is famous, the Meditations, was written during the last years of his military campaigns

notes: Hồ sơ ghi 'k. 170–180', trình rút lấy 170. Khoảng ước đoán này bao trùm ước đoán IEP 'c. 171–175' và khớp SEP (những năm chinh chiến cuối, mất 180). year_note: 'soạn k. 170–180 (IEP: c. 171–175)'.
